events.title: Executive Order 14434 — 'Super Intelligence' AI Policy Shift
events.why_it_matters: Mandates executive-branch terminology shift from 'AI' to 'Super Intelligence,' signaling deregulatory posture and US AI leadership priority that affects chip and software demand outlook.
events.what_to_watch: Agency implementation guidance and whether it accelerates or complicates federal AI procurement and export controls.

events.title: Executive Order 14435 — Emergency Diesel Tax Relief
events.why_it_matters: Temporarily allows road vehicles to use dyed diesel and defers federal excise taxes, lowering transport costs and easing diesel supply tightness.
events.what_to_watch: Duration of relief and whether it expands to broader fuel-tax suspension amid elevated energy costs.

events.title: Final Reciprocal Tariff Rates — 10–12.5% on 60 Economies; Canada Raised to 35%
events.why_it_matters: Replaces expired temporary global 10% tariff, covers 99.4% of US imports, and raises Canada duties to 35%, escalating trade friction and input-cost pressure across sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Retaliatory measures from EU, Canada, and Japan; Section 301 exclusions expiry Nov 2026.

events.title: Section 301 Exclusions Expiry — November 2026 Deadline
events.why_it_matters: Three separate US tariff measures lapse on Nov 9–10 with no extension on record, threatening cost increases for importers of Chinese goods ahead of the broader truce deadline in January.
events.what_to_watch: Whether USTR announces extensions or lets exclusions expire, and China's response.

events.title: SEC Quorum Rule Change — Single-Commissioner Approval Effective
events.why_it_matters: Lowers the quorum threshold to allow one commissioner to approve formal rules, centralizing crypto and securities regulatory power and potentially accelerating deregulatory actions.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the rule is challenged in court and the pace of new crypto-related rulemakings.

events.title: SEC Proposes Crypto Asset Self-Custody Rule
events.why_it_matters: Modernizes custody rules for advisers and investment companies to include crypto assets, potentially unlocking institutional crypto allocation.
events.what_to_watch: Comment period and whether the proposal survives potential litigation.

events.title: SEC Innovation Exemption — Tokenized US Stocks Trading Framework
events.why_it_matters: Creates a five-year regulatory framework for trading tokenized versions of major US exchange-listed stocks, potentially disrupting traditional brokerage and exchange models.
events.what_to_watch: Whether major exchanges and brokerages adopt the framework and how it interacts with existing securities laws.

events.title: Continuing Resolution Funds Government Through Dec 11
events.why_it_matters: Avoids near-term shutdown but pushes FY27 appropriations to a post-election lame-duck session, creating fiscal cliff risk in December.
events.what_to_watch: Lame-duck negotiations and whether a December shutdown risk materializes.

events.title: FY27 Appropriations — Post-Election Lame-Duck Session
events.why_it_matters: Congress returns after midterms facing a crowded year-end agenda including government funding, debt ceiling, and tax extenders.
events.what_to_watch: Whether leaders can reach a bipartisan deal before the Dec 11 CR expiration.

events.title: Supreme Court Sides with GOP on TV Political Ad Rates
events.why_it_matters: Clears way for political parties to receive favorable advertising rates ahead of midterms, benefiting broadcasters and political ad spend.
events.what_to_watch: Whether further appeals or legislative fixes emerge.

events.title: Supreme Court Grants Cert in DOGE Service Cases
events.why_it_matters: SCOTUS will hear cases involving the Department of Government Efficiency's authority, with implications for federal agency restructuring and spending.
events.what_to_watch: Oral argument scheduling and potential impacts on federal workforce and contracting.

events.title: FOMC Meeting — Oct 27-28; Market Prices Hold
events.why_it_matters: Fed Chair Warsh signaled no pre-judgment on rates; market now prices ~73% probability of hold, with hike odds falling after his IMF remarks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Warsh provides explicit forward guidance and the vote split on the committee.

events.title: US September CPI Released — M/M 0.6% Expected
events.why_it_matters: CPI m/m expected to widen from 0.4% to 0.6%, core inflation upside surprise pressures Fed rate path and bond yields.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI details and whether the print shifts December hike expectations.

events.title: ECB Rate Decision — Oct 29; Expected Hold
events.why_it_matters: Market expects ECB to hold deposit rate at 2.50%, but officials including Simkus have not ruled out a hike amid persistent price pressures.
events.what_to_watch: ECB statement language and whether a December hike is explicitly flagged.

events.title: Bank of Japan Rate Decision — Oct 29-30; Expected Hold
events.why_it_matters: BOJ officials lean against back-to-back hike after raising to 1.25% in September, but retain December hike option; yen weakness persists.
events.what_to_watch: Ueda's press conference tone and updated quarterly economic projections.

events.title: Bank of Korea Rate Decision — Oct 22; Expected Hold at 3.00%
events.why_it_matters: Morgan Stanley, Citi, BNP, SC all forecast unanimous or near-unanimous hold after two hikes in July-August, with hawkish dissent possible.
events.what_to_watch: Number of dissenting votes for a hike and signals about November tightening.

events.title: China Q3 GDP and September Activity Data — Oct 19
events.why_it_matters: Market expects Q3 GDP ~4.4% y/y, with industrial production strong and retail sales still weak; stimulus measures are supporting growth.
events.what_to_watch: Whether GDP beats 4.4% and if property investment stabilizes.

events.title: China 1-Year Loan Prime Rate — Oct 20
events.why_it_matters: PBoC's monthly LPR fixing will signal whether further rate cuts are coming to support the property sector and consumption.
events.what_to_watch: Any cut to the 1-year or 5-year LPR and accompanying PBoC liquidity operations.

events.title: Netflix Q3 2026 Earnings — Oct 20
events.why_it_matters: Consensus expects revenue $12.876B (+11.9% y/y) and EPS $0.831; ad-tier growth and password-sharing monetization are key.
events.what_to_watch: Ad revenue growth trajectory, subscriber adds, and 2026 content spend guidance.

events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 Earnings — Oct 21
events.why_it_matters: TSLA down nearly 20% YTD; deliveries and margin pressure in focus, with robotaxi and AI narrative facing scrutiny.
events.what_to_watch: Automotive gross margin, Cybertruck ramp, and any update on FSD/robotaxi timeline.

events.title: Meta Platforms Q3 2026 Earnings — Oct 21 (est.)
events.why_it_matters: Market re-rating Meta from 'AI spender' to 'AI monetizer'; Muse AI product monetization and ad revenue growth are critical.
events.what_to_watch: Reality Labs losses, AI capex guidance, and ad pricing trends.

events.title: TSMC Q3 2026 Earnings — Record Profit Beat
events.why_it_matters: Net profit NT$763.06B (+68.7% y/y), sixth consecutive record; advanced nodes 79% of wafer revenue; raised full-year guidance and capex to $64B.
events.what_to_watch: Whether AI-driven demand sustains into 2027 and 2nm ramp execution.

events.title: Mega-Cap Earnings Week — NFLX, TSLA, META, LMT, GM, AXP, IBM, KO
events.why_it_matters: Heaviest week of Q3 earnings with major sector bellwethers across tech, autos, defense, and financials; guidance will set tone for Q4.
events.what_to_watch: Whether tech beats are enough to offset auto and industrial headwinds from tariffs and slowing global demand.

events.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Investor Day — Targeting $2T Valuation
events.why_it_matters: Anthropic disclosed Q3 revenue ~$16.8B to investors; targeting a November IPO at up to $2T valuation, potentially the largest ever, surpassing SpaceX's $1.8T.
events.what_to_watch: Whether valuation expectations hold amid reports some investors are trimming estimates, and exact listing date post-midterms.

events.title: Paras Healthcare IPO — Opens Oct 21, Lists Oct 28
events.why_it_matters: Indian healthcare IPO adds to a busy EM issuance calendar; pricing and subscription levels signal risk appetite for Indian equities.
events.what_to_watch: Subscription levels and first-day trading performance.

events.title: OPEC+ Meeting — Nov 1 Output Decision
events.why_it_matters: Seven OPEC+ nations paused production increases in October and will review market conditions on Nov 1; a decision to raise or hold output will impact oil prices.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Saudi-Russia cohesion holds and the group's assessment of demand amid Middle East supply risks.

events.title: US-Israel Weighing Strikes on Iran Before Elections
events.why_it_matters: Netanyahu and Trump reportedly discussed large-scale joint military strikes on Iran before Israel's Oct 27 election and US midterms; escalation would spike oil and risk-off assets.
events.what_to_watch: Any confirmed strike activity, Iranian retaliation, and Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions.

events.title: Saudi-Houthi Conflict Escalation — Aramco Facility Attacked
events.why_it_matters: Houthi missile and drone attacks on Saudi cities and Aramco facilities in Dhahran escalate regional supply risk; Saudi-led coalition intercepts continue.
events.what_to_watch: Whether attacks expand to Abqaiq or other major processing facilities.

events.title: Brazil Presidential Runoff — Oct 25
events.why_it_matters: Flavio Bolsonaro edged Lula 47%-45% in first round; runoff outcome will shape Brazil's fiscal policy, trade relations, and commodity outlook.
events.what_to_watch: Polling shifts in final week and market reaction to Bolsonaro's strong first-round showing.

events.title: Japan Lower House Election — Oct 27
events.why_it_matters: PM Takaichi's LDP expected to win supermajority; a strong mandate could accelerate fiscal stimulus and defense spending, boosting Japanese equities and JGB issuance.
events.what_to_watch: Seat count and whether LDP-Komeito coalition secures two-thirds majority to amend constitution.

events.title: GCC-EU Summit — Saudi Arabia, October
events.why_it_matters: Second GCC-EU summit to deepen trade, energy, and investment ties amid global trade fragmentation.
events.what_to_watch: Any announced energy supply agreements or investment MOUs.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine Peace Talks — Possible October Round
events.why_it_matters: US proposed trilateral peace talks in October, per Zelensky; any credible de-escalation would lower European energy risk premia and commodity prices.
events.what_to_watch: Whether talks materialize and Russia's participation.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias Aftermath — Florida Panhandle and Alabama
events.why_it_matters: Category 2 landfall near Destin caused at least 5 deaths, widespread power outages for hundreds of thousands, and flooding across the Southeast.
events.what_to_watch: Insured loss estimates and whether utility restoration costs affect Q4 earnings.

events.title: Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel — Mexico Pacific Coast
events.why_it_matters: Hurricane Simon hit Category 4 strength near Mexico's west coast; death toll reached 6 with flooding and landslides in Nayarit and Sinaloa.
events.what_to_watch: Impact on Mexican agricultural exports and Pacific port operations.

events.title: International Dockworkers' Strike Against Arms Shipments — Oct 30
events.why_it_matters: Port workers across multiple countries plan strikes against weapons transit and rearmament policies, potentially disrupting global shipping schedules.
events.what_to_watch: Scope of participation and duration of any work stoppages at major ports.

events.title: South Korea Heat Wave — Semiconductor Supply Chain Risk
events.why_it_matters: Record heat triggered 'national disaster' status, straining power and water supplies critical to Samsung and SK Hynix memory fabs; 2027 DRAM/HBM capacity pre-sold out.
events.what_to_watch: Whether heat-related production cuts affect Q4 memory pricing and AI chip supply.

events.title: US-Mexico Trade Talks Stall Over Tariff Reductions
events.why_it_matters: Commerce Secretary Lutnick opposed substantial reductions in 25% vehicle tariffs and 50% steel/aluminum tariffs on Mexico, dimming prospects for a near-term deal.
events.what_to_watch: Whether talks resume and if Mexico retaliates with its own tariffs.

events.title: Oura Inc IPO — Priced at $40-44, Listed Oct 1
events.why_it_matters: Wearable health-tech IPO raised ~$2.2B, testing investor appetite for consumer hardware meets health data plays.
events.what_to_watch: Post-IPO lockup expiry and early trading volatility.

events.title: Iambic Therapeutics and City Therapeutics Biotech IPOs
events.why_it_matters: Two biotech IPOs raised ~$160M and ~$185M respectively; performance signals biotech IPO window health.
events.what_to_watch: First-week trading and whether more biotechs follow.

events.title: US PPI September 2026 — Released with CPI
events.why_it_matters: PPI for September released alongside CPI; pipeline inflation pressures inform Fed's rate path amid tariff-driven cost increases.
events.what_to_watch: Core PPI components and whether tariff pass-through is visible.

top_risks: US-Israel joint military strikes on Iran before Oct 27 Israeli election and Nov 3 US midterms — could spike oil above $100 and trigger broad risk-off.
September CPI core inflation upside surprise forces Fed to signal December hike, pushing 10-year yields higher and pressuring equities.
Final reciprocal tariffs (10-12.5% on 60 economies, Canada at 35%) escalate into full retaliatory trade war, hitting global growth and corporate margins.
Anthropic IPO at $2T valuation could drain liquidity from AI-adjacent names if pricing disappoints or post-IPO trading breaks issue price.
Saudi-Houthi escalation damaging Aramco facilities would tighten global oil supply amid already elevated geopolitical risk.
top_opportunities: Fed hold on Oct 28 combined with slowing core CPI could spark a broad risk rally, particularly in rate-sensitive sectors (Real Estate, Utilities, Technology).
Japan LDP supermajority on Oct 27 enables fiscal stimulus and defense spending, bullish for Japanese equities and industrials.
China Q3 GDP beat (>4.4%) plus further stimulus signals could lift commodity-linked EM equities and Basic Materials.
Anthropic IPO at $2T valuation validates AI monetization narrative, potentially lifting enterprise software and cloud infrastructure names.
Netflix and Meta ad-revenue beats could confirm resilient consumer digital spending despite macro headwinds.
summary: The next two weeks are dominated by US mega-cap earnings (NFLX, TSLA, META), the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting where a hold is priced at ~73%, and key macro data from China (Q3 GDP Oct 19). Geopolitical risk is elevated with US-Israel weighing strikes on Iran before elections, escalating Saudi-Houthi attacks on Aramco facilities, and the Brazil runoff on Oct 25. The final reciprocal tariff regime covering 99.4% of US imports took effect, with Section 301 exclusions expiring in November adding to trade uncertainty. Anthropic's pre-IPO investor day disclosed $16.8B quarterly revenue ahead of a possible $2T November listing.
